purpose: Source-backed operating event telemetry for The Holding console and future Curators.

coverageGaps.why: No canonical protocol-volume time series is bound to Event Intelligence yet.
No canonical cross-protocol fee/revenue time series is bound yet.
APR/reward changes cannot be causally attributed to protocol fees without mechanism-specific evidence.
Current reward history records USD value changes but not a canonical per-interval unit-vs-price decomposition for every route.
No canonical daily company-wide asset-weight history is bound to this layer yet.
Index movement event semantics require a dedicated canonical time-series contract before promotion.
